title: Chapter 155: New Zerg Troops
content:
Chapter 155: New Zerg Troops

Wu Qing handed the follow-up matters to the Queen of Insects, and arranged a task for Wu Cong to lead the army to patrol and guard outside the city. After he was away from him, his consciousness returned to his body.

The Queen of Insects's explosion just now once again met the conditions for the Zerg mother nest to be upgraded to three stars!

Even the conditions for the Zerg mother nest to be upgraded to four stars have become 1/10!

This shows that the true strength of the evil god's high priest has reached four stars!

It is unknown how many three-star personnel there are in the evil god's army. After meeting the conditions for the upgrade of the Zerg mother nest, the system will no longer record them.

[I hope readers will remember our domain name Taiwan Novel Network →𝐭𝐰𝐤𝐚𝐧.𝐜𝐨𝐦]

No matter how strong they are, they are transformed into system resources and become a number in the system record in the Queen of Insects' attack!

Meeting the conditions for the Zerg mother nest to be upgraded to two stars in a row is the biggest gain of this war!

In the Zerg ground territory, Wu Qing's main body came out of the Zerg mother nest that was initially materialized by the system. He selected the mother nest in front of him in the system operation panel. The system prompted that the mother nest could skip two stars and upgrade directly to three stars!

Wu Qing calculated the resources that need to be consumed. For each star upgrade, it is about double the previous star, and no gas resources are needed.

This resource consumption is not much, and it does not consume gas resources. It can be seen that the most difficult thing about upgrading the star of the Zerg mother nest is to meet the conditions set by the system, rather than resource restrictions.

On the contrary, the consumption of the star upgrade of the arms is one to three times the previous star, and the amount of consumption corresponds to the increase in the combat power of the arms. This is a restriction on the star upgrade of the arms in terms of resources.

Wu Qing immediately chose to upgrade the mother nest in front of him to three stars!

The system resources are consumed, and the mother nest changes into a giant pupa, constantly wriggling, and soon changes back to the mother nest again.

The three-star mother nest occupies a larger area. Perhaps in order to adapt to the environment where the Zerg buildings cannot expand to the surroundings without limit, a large part of the three-star mother nest goes deep underground.

So it seems that the ground part of the three-star nest has not changed much, but there is a part of the nest organization underground.

The larvae produced by the three-star nest no longer crawl out, but sleep inside the nest. The three-star nest can store 270 larvae at the same time. After the larvae hatch, 90 larvae can be produced every minute!

This amount of larvae storage and production speed will greatly increase the speed of the Zerg's rapid troops!

The larvae will decide whether to hatch in the nest or outside the nest according to the size of the Zerg troops to be hatched. This method is more in line with the reality.

The three-star nest is not Wu Qing's ultimate goal. Wu Qing continues to select the three-star nest in the system operation panel. The system prompts that the nest has met the conditions for evolving into the beast cave form!

The beast cave is the translation of the name of the original game. In fact, what is the relationship between the Zerg nest and the beast? Wu Qing doesn't understand. He only knows that when the nest evolves to the beast cave form, the entire Zerg has entered the intermediate stage from the primary stage!

If you play games, the primary stage is the short period of time when the game starts. Except for fast attacks and counterattacks against the enemy's fast attacks, this stage is generally focused on development and rarely starts a war.

Only when it is upgraded to the intermediate stage of the beast cave, the Zerg's combat arms are enriched, many abilities are unlocked and upgraded, and more tactics can be used, and you can fight to your heart's content!

Wu Qing has been waiting for this moment for a long time!

Wu Qing chose to evolve the mother nest to the beast cave form on the system operation panel. The mother nest pupated again and began to wriggle constantly!

This time it took a long time, and Wu Qing waited patiently.

Finally, the wriggling pupa began to transform and eventually turned into a Zerg building similar to the mother nest, but more hideous and terrifying.

At this moment, the system's operation panel was updated, and some more things came out.

Wu Qing took a look. The mother nest in the beast cave form itself had the same original ability, and there were three more upgrade options for upgrading the Zerg host.

The first upgrade option is the abdominal sac, which allows the Zerg host to obtain the ability to transport Zerg troops.

This ability looks very simple in the game. After the upgrade, the host can load and transport Zerg ground troops without any changes. This is definitely not realistic in reality!

With the current size of the host, even if a space is evolved in their abdomen, it can't load much.

Wu Qing carefully checked the description of this upgrade and found that the system has indeed optimized the settings for this problem.

The description introduces that if this upgrade item is upgraded, the host will be upgraded to three stars, and there will be an additional abdominal sac evolution option, just like the evolution of the hydralisk into the stealth spider, and the evolution of the dragon into the air guard and the devourer.

Select the three-star host and select the abdominal sac evolution option, and the host will evolve into the transport form.

In order to increase the abdominal sac space, the host in the transport form will evolve in the direction of giantization, and after evolution, it will be many times larger than the normal host.

Zerg hosts will have two forms in the future, normal form and transport form. Whether to evolve to the transport form can be selected according to actual needs.

The second upgrade option is the antenna, which can increase the detection distance of the host and enhance the detection ability of the host.

If you choose to upgrade the tentacles, the detection distance and detection capabilities of all Zerg hosts will be increased and enhanced, which is the same as the upgrade option that increases the attack power and defense power of all ground forces.

The third upgrade option is aerodynamic armor, which can greatly increase the host's flight speed.

This chapter is not over yet, please click the next page to continue reading!

Only with speed can the host truly become a transport unit of the Zerg. If the speed is not as fast as the Zerg running on the ground, the host's transportation function will be greatly weakened.

With faster flight speed, the host's safety will also be greatly improved.

In the mother nest in the form of a beast cave, these three upgrade options for the host completely unlock the host's various abilities, making the host an indispensable and important member of the Zerg.

…

The enhancement of the host is worth celebrating, but Wu Qing is most concerned about the new Zerg soldiers unlocked by the evolution of the mother nest to the beast cave form!

The Zerg has always relied on Zerg Zerglings and Hydralisks to conquer the world. The cooperation of the two arms has too few optional tactics, which often leads to a large number of casualties of Zerg Zerglings.

Therefore, the Zerg urgently needs new arms to enrich the optional tactics. Only with a variety of arms can they win more beautiful victories.

Wu Qing quickly learned about the new arms unlocked by the Zerg through the system.

There are four types of soldiers in total. If you want them to appear, you need to build two newly unlocked Zerg buildings and upgrade a newly unlocked upgrade option.

Building the newly unlocked building Air Force Tower can provide the larvae with the genes of two Zerg flying soldiers, Mutalisks and Scourges, so that the larvae can hatch these two new soldiers.

The Air Force Tower also provides the Zerg air force with attack and defense upgrade options. Through upgrades, the attack and defense of all Zerg flying soldiers can be strengthened.

Building the newly unlocked building Queen's Nest can provide the larvae with the genes of the new soldier Queen, so that the larvae can hatch the special soldier with a scary name, Queen.

The Queen's Nest also provides the Queen with a variety of special skills evolution options.

The last soldier, the Stealth Spider, is evolved from the Hydralisk. Its evolution upgrade option is in the Hydralisk Nest building. Selecting the upgrade evolution to Stealth Spider option can unlock the Stealth Spider gene on the Hydralisk.

When needed, the Hydralisk consumes resources and activates the Stealth Spider gene on its body, and it can evolve into a Stealth Spider on the spot.

…

The troop that Wu Qing values most is the first aerial combat troop of the Zerg, the Mutalisk. As the most basic flying troop of the Zerg, the Mutalisk, like the Zerg Zergling, is a Zerg troop that can use aerial swarm tactics!

The Mutalisk has an extremely fast flight speed and can take into account both air and ground attacks. Their one attack can attack multiple enemies at the same time, which is a surface killing attack. They are a very comprehensive aerial combat troop!

This is how it is set in the game, and you still need to see it with your own eyes.

Wu Qing transferred two worker bees, selected an open space on the fungal blanket, built an air force tower, and also built the queen's nest.

The two buildings kept changing, and the air force tower was built first.

Wu Qing selected a larva crawling on the edge of the mother nest. On the system operation panel, the larvae can hatch more Zerg troop types, including Mutalisk and Explosive Mosquito.

Wu Qing chose to hatch the Mutalisk, consuming 100 energy and 100 gas. The larva turned into a large pupa and continued to expand.

After a while, a Zerg that looked bigger than a one-star hydralisk emerged from the giant pupa!

Its body structure looked somewhat similar to the flying dragon in the game, but not exactly the same. It should be the result of the system's real-life optimization.

Overall, it looked like a special Zerg with wings. It was special because its body was no longer a long worm, but somewhat similar to the flying dragon in the magical world, with claws that allowed it to land steadily on the ground.

The flying dragons in the real world could not fly in the air forever like in the game. They could land, which was a setting suitable for reality.

After such a setting adjustment, the flying dragon of the Zerg was essentially a Zerg, but its appearance was somewhat similar to the flying dragon in the magical world.

Wu Qing ordered the flying dragon to fly up, and the flying dragon's strong and powerful hind legs pushed hard, and the wide periosteal wings stretched out, and with a light flap, it flew up!

The wingspan of the flying dragon was wide enough for it to fly in the air for a long time at high speed.

The flying dragon flew around the Zerg territory, and its flying speed was very fast, far exceeding the current Zerg host.

In the game setting, the dragon is also the fastest Zerg soldier, and this seems to have been perfectly inherited in reality.
